import importlib
import semver
importlib.reload(semver)

# Check R6: CLI functions exposed
print("createparser:", hasattr(semver, 'createparser'))
print("main:", hasattr(semver, 'main'))
print("process:", hasattr(semver, 'process'))

# Check R7: replace function exposed
print("replace (module):", hasattr(semver, 'replace'))

# Check VersionInfo has replace method
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print("replace method:", hasattr(vi, 'replace'))

# Check bump methods
print("bump_major:", hasattr(vi, 'bump_major'))
print("bump_minor:", hasattr(vi, 'bump_minor'))
print("bump_patch:", hasattr(vi, 'bump_patch'))
print("bump_prerelease:", hasattr(vi, 'bump_prerelease'))
print("bump_build:", hasattr(vi, 'bump_build'))

# Test tuple comparison
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print("tuple eq:", v == (1, 2, 3))
print("str disallowed:", not (v == "1.2.3"))
print("int disallowed:", not (v == 1))

# Test immutability
try:
    v.major = 5
    print("IMMUTABLE: FAILED")
except AttributeError:
    print("IMMUTABLE: OK")

# Test iteration
result = list(v)
print("iteration:", result)

# Test type conversion in constructor
v2 = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 'alpha', 'build')
print("type check:", type(v2.major), type(v2.prerelease), type(v2.build))

# Test replace function
print("module replace:", semver.replace("1.2.3", major=2))
print("method replace:", str(v.replace(major=2)))

# Test bump methods return new instances
vb = v.bump_major()
print("bump_major returns new:", vb != v, type(vb))
